mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.host_id, h.title, h.city, h.address, h.cover_img, h.type, h.price, h.original_price, h.max_guests, h.bedrooms, h.beds, h.rating, h.review_count, h.favorite_count, h.status FROM favorite f INNER JOIN homestay h ON h.id = f.homestay_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
